CPopcorn_render. Other half of the same nearest-neighbour argument (243<->242 vs 243<->253).
CRainDrop_render. Mutual nearest neighbour by instruction count against CPopcorn_render (254<->253 vs 254<->242), and consistent with the vtable slot structure in both builds.

CRaindrop_ctor. Not a section-D candidate only because nocturne spells the class CRaindrop here while its own render/onCollision use CRainDrop. Same vtable-stride evidence as CPopcorn_ctor: ctors at stride 0x30 and vtables at stride 0x20 in identical order in both builds, third slot anchored by CShell.
CRaindrop_dtor. Adjacency to its ctor; body is byte-identical to the other two particle dtors so nothing else separates it.

CPopcorn_ctor. Distinguished from CRainDrop_ctor by which vtable it stores. The two renders those vtables point at are separable by size and mutually nearest: RainDrop 254insn/930B <-> 253/929, Popcorn 243/872 <-> 242/868; the cross pairings are 10-12 insn apart. Body evidence, not names.
CPopcorn_dtor. Adjacency to CPopcorn_ctor, as for CShell_dtor.

CShell_ctor. Forced by the vtable it stores: every slot of g_CShellVTable (CParticle_setup, CShell_process, CShell_render, CShell_onCollision) is already a matched pair, so the vtable is identified without reference to any name.

CShell_dtor. The three core_fire.cpp particle dtors are byte-identical to each other in both builds -- no discriminator in the body at all. Pinned by adjacency: each dtor sits 0x20 after its own ctor, same stride in both builds, and CShell_ctor is anchored by its vtable.
